title: Natural-sort follow-ups from #604: correct the digit-bearing-prefix CHANGELOG wording and test the untested numeric-order sites
description: Maintainer follow-up to the outside contribution opum-ai/quest-cli#604 (squash a28c8182, closes issue opum-ai/quest-cli#603; tracked under QCLI-497, DEC-181). Two non-blocking review findings are taken on by the maintainers rather than asked of the contributor (team-lead ruling 2026-10-13). (2) The Unreleased CHANGELOG entry says "Prefixes still compare as text". That is false for a prefix containing digits, which the canonical prefix pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]* allows: taskIdSortKey pads every digit run, so A2B-1 now sorts before A10B-1. (3) compareTaskIds replaced string order at call sites that have no test pinning the numeric order: task search (searchTasks, empty and non-empty query), task list --across-refs (default order and --sort id), planning board (status-column and milestone taskIds), and doctor planning issues (vocabulary, resolution, milestone_task_not_found and off-flow issue order). Finding (1), digit runs over 20 digits not ordering numerically, is recorded on QCLI-497 and is out of scope here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CHANGELOG sentence about prefixes states the real behaviour for a prefix containing digits, or is removed.

Each of task search, task list --across-refs, planning board and the doctor planning issues has a test whose ids cross a digit-count boundary (for example T-2 and T-10) and that fails when its call site is reverted to localeCompare.
